conviction_note: This is the first Dadelo quarter with no preliminary figures, because the company stopped them on 2026-06-03, so revenue, EBITDA and profit all reach the market together. On a $189k/day name whose new-information days moved +14.0% (Q1 report), +12.2% (H1 preliminary) and -7.8% (FY/covenant), that sets abs_move at 8%. The direction is close to a coin: the CEO's own 21 Aug framing ('H2 a bit worse', FY +50-55%) implies H2 growth of +28% to +45%, under Trigon's ~+50% Q3 bar, and the Q3 2025 comparison was +68.5%. Against that, the CEO and his family foundation kept buying through 17 Sep, knowing July and August trading, and the stock has already fallen 13% in October. So p_up is 48, the scaled number is -0.32, and the findings net to +0.1. The two measurements differ in sign by a few tenths: the findings roughly offset, and the slight negative in p_up comes from the bar being set by one broker above management's own implied range. It is not a contradiction. One weak inference is left out of the numbers: after the June decision the company still published H1 as MAR 17(1) inside information, and nothing has come for Q3, which hints at no extreme deviation but cannot be scored.

already_public.what: Nothing of Q3 2026 is out. The company announced it would stop publishing estimated quarterly revenue ('zaprzestaniu publikacji informacji o szacunkowych kwartalnych przychodach'). In 2023, 2024 and 2025 it published Q3 preliminary revenue in early October (2025-10-02: 134.2m PLN, +68.5%). No such report exists for Q3 2026 on the full StockWatch ESPI list (latest Dadelo item 2026-09-17).

H1 2026 preliminary results, filed as MAR 17(1) inside information despite the June decision: revenue 406.5m PLN (+67%), Q2 263.1m (+65%), H1 EBITDA 53.03m (+98%), net profit >32m (+91%). The stock rose 12.2% that day.

FY2026 target from the CEO on the H1 call: about 700m PLN revenue, with 'H2 a bit worse' and FY growth of 50-55%. He also targets 1bn PLN in 2027 and a Czech entry in 2027, possibly by acquisition, with the decision due by year-end.
Report date: the issuer's own 2026 schedule (RB 5/2026) puts the Q3 2026 report on 17 November 2026.

new_in_release.expect: All of Q3 is new: revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and net profit. My expectation is revenue growth of about +40-48% y/y on 134.6m (roughly 188-199m PLN), slightly under Trigon's ~+50% (~202m), with gross margin up y/y on the cheaply bought stock. Net profit is roughly in line with Trigon's +60-70% (15-16m on 9.5m). The sign against the bar is uncertain.

Probably a reiteration of 'about 700m' for FY2026 and the 1bn ambition for 2027 on the call or in the report commentary. A cut to the 50-55% end would land as a negative, and a Czech entry or acquisition decision (promised by year-end) could arrive. Unknown.

Unknown, risk negative. Inventory is 72% of assets at H1 (up 29.65% y/y), and pre-buying for the 2027 season plus a new warehouse planned for Q1 2027 could make Q3 operating cash flow negative. This is the Luceco pattern, but I have no Q3 number.
No change expected. The CEO said dividends come later, once growth slows.

Its own ESPI timestamps for recent periodic reports are mixed: Q1 2026 at 08:45 (before the 09:00 open), H1 2026 at 17:05 and FY2025 at 17:58 (after the close), Q3 2025 at 14:16 (in session), Q3 2024 at 07:04, Q3 2023 at 17:07. positioning_check: No register for this market. The KNF short register (rss.knf.gov.pl) returns 403 to this container, and gpw.pl/espi.pap.pl refuse, so positioning.covered is false. That means nothing is known about short interest, not that there is none. priced_lean_pct (+0.28) is the 20-day run-up (-5.54%) alone, which is also the free control. The only positioning evidence is insider flow: the CEO and his family foundation bought repeatedly from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-17 (MAR art. 19 notices). The free float is about 33%, with Oponeo.pl holding 58.8%.

findings.finding: This is the first quarter in at least four years without a preliminary revenue release, because the board stopped publishing estimated quarterly revenue on 2026-06-03. The Q3 2026 numbers, which in past years were half-known from an early-October estimate, are therefore entirely new on 17 November. This is a size fact, not a direction fact.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When revenue was not yet known, the release days moved: Q1 2026 report +14.04% (2026-05-20, profit was the new part), H1 preliminary +12.16% (2026-07-10). After full pre-release the moves were smaller: H1 report -3.49% (2026-08-19).
findings.original_quote: Zarząd DADELO S.A. [...] informuje, iż podjął decyzję o zaprzestaniu publikacji informacji o szacunkowych kwartalnych przychodach Spółki. (The Management Board has decided to stop publishing estimated quarterly revenue.)
findings.why_not_priced: This carries no sign, so it moves abs_move_pct only, up from the ~3% pre-released base to about 8%. If the market had priced the missing pre-release, someone would have published a Q3 revenue estimate in October. None appears in Bankier, Strefa, Parkiet or StockWatch, and the only Q3 number on record is Trigon's July estimate.
findings.independence: Absence is confirmed on the full ESPI list: https://www.stockwatch.pl/komunikaty-spolek/wszystkie.aspx?page=0&type=&t=dadelo (Q3 preliminary reports exist for 2021-2025, none for 2026).

findings.finding: On the 21 Aug H1 call the CEO framed H2 as 'a bit worse' and FY growth at 50-55% (666-688m on 444m), while also saying 'about 700m'. That implies H2 2026 revenue of 258-292m, i.e. +28% to +45% on H2 2025's ~201m. The only Q3 sell-side bar, Trigon's ~+50% (~202m), sits above even the top of that range, and Q3 2025's comparison was +68.5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue was the line that moved the stock: the H1 preliminary beat moved it +12.2%. The FY2025 report day fell 7.8%, but that was on a covenant breach, not revenue. There is no observed reaction to a revenue miss.
findings.original_quote: "Mieliśmy 408 mln zł przychodów w pierwszym półroczu, drugie półrocze jest trochę gorsze, ale (…) myślę, że w tym roku 'dociągniemy', że tak brzydko powiem, 50-55 proc. wzrostu. Podejdziemy pod ok. 700 mln zł przychodów." (We had 408m in H1, H2 is somewhat worse, but I think this year we will 'drag it' to 50-55% growth. We will approach about 700m in revenue.)
findings.why_not_priced: The quote is public and in the PAP wire copy, so part of it is priced. The stock is down from 105 (2026-09-21) to 92. What is not visible is anyone converting it into a Q3 number: the only published Q3 bar (Trigon, +50%) predates it and was not revised in anything found. If the market had adopted the CEO's implied +28-45% H2 range, a revised broker number or a preview would carry it.
findings.independence: Trigon's July bar for the comparison: https://www.gpw.pl/pub/pwpa/20260721_trigon_dom_maklerski_dad_pl_ra.pdf ('W 3Q26 dynamika sprzedaży powinna [...] wynieść około 50% r/r'). Nothing independent says the quarter is weak.

findings.finding: The CEO and his family foundation bought Dadelo shares on at least eight sessions from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-17 at about 82-98 PLN. Examples: 3,320 shares at 97.36 avg on 09-15 and 3,272 at 97.51 on 09-14. The buying was done with July and August trading, two of Q3's three months, known to the buyer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: He is a serial buyer, with dozens of notices since 2023. He also sold once after a print (2025-11-19, after the Q3 2025 report, when the stock fell). His buying has not reliably preceded beats.
findings.original_quote: Łączny wolumen 3320 - Cena 97,36 PLN - Data transakcji 2026-09-15 (attached notice, Zawieruszyński Fundacja Rodzinna; https://www.biznesradar.pl/storage/a/55/08/55080319-zal01-zawiadomienie-art-19-mar-fr-2ef132d.pdf)
findings.why_not_priced: These notices are public, and Parkiet ran the story on 2026-09-23. The stock then fell 13% in October, from about 99 to 86, which says the market did not hold the insider signal as a read on Q3. If it had, the price would not sit below where the CEO bought. Daily amounts are small (about 0.3m PLN), and he is a habitual buyer, so the size is small.
findings.independence: https://www.parkiet.com/handel-i-konsumpcja/art45174811-akcje-dadelo-na-celowniku-kupujacych-co-pcha-kurs-w-gore (2026-09-23, same facts, not independent evidence on Q3).

findings.finding: Gross margin should stay supported in Q3. In March the company said its late-2025 stock was 'bought at very attractive prices' to be sold in 2026, and H1 2026 gross margin was 32.93% against 31.99% a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 report day (+14.0%) was a profit and margin surprise after revenue had been pre-released. Margin is the line this stock has re-rated on.
findings.original_quote: nie spełnienie kowenantów [...] miało miejsce w wyniku zakupu znacznej ilości towaru po bardzo atrakcyjnych cenach, którego sprzedaż Spółka będzie realizowała w roku 2026. (The covenant breach resulted from buying a large quantity of goods at very attractive prices, which the company will sell in 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Trigon already assumes 'w 3Q trend wzrostu marży r/r powinien się utrzymać' (the y/y margin gain continues in Q3), so this lands inside the bar and is sized near zero. It only adds if the margin gain is larger than Trigon's +100bp, and nothing shows that.
findings.independence: H1 2026 management report, gross margin 32.93% vs 31.99%: https://bonnier.pl/static/att/emitent/2026-08/20260818_170501_0409077528_Sprawozdanie_Zarzadu_za_HY2026_DADELO_SA_finalne.pdf

findings.finding: Dadelo redeemed its 50m PLN Series A bonds in June 2026, 2.3 years early. The company says this lowers finance costs in later periods and removes the covenant-linked coupon step-up, so Q3 is the first full quarter without that coupon.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior reaction on this line. The covenant breach itself produced the -7.8% day on 2026-03-19.
findings.original_quote: W czerwcu 2026 roku Spółka spłaciła obligacje serii A wyemitowane w październiku 2025 roku [...] co obniży koszty finansowe w kolejnych okresach i usunie ryzyko podwyższenia oprocentowania odsetek od obligacji w przypadku przekroczenia wskaźników finansowych dla obligacji.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, but the money is small: on a 50m PLN bond a few percentage points of coupon is about 0.5-1m PLN a quarter against a ~15m net profit bar. Asking what the money buys, the redemption was funded by operations and bank lines, not new equity, so it is not a distress signal. It is sized small and positive.

outside_window.finding: KNF review, opened in March 2026, of Dadelo's disclosure of the covenant breach and of shareholder transactions in its shares. No outcome is dated and nothing suggests it resolves on the print.
Czech market entry decision (acquisition of a target with about 100m PLN of Czech sales, or organic), promised 'by year-end'. It could come with the Q3 report but is not dated to it.

baseline_tension: The findings do not contradict the lean (+0.28, the run-up alone) and do not agree with it either. They net to roughly zero. The one directional lean, a revenue growth bar set above management's own implied H2 range, is orthogonal to the run-up, and it is a small negative while the 60-day run-up is +11.5% and the 5-day +6.0%.
language_note: The June 2026 board decision to stop quarterly revenue estimates exists only as a Polish ESPI current report (RB 24/2026). Without it the hunt would have assumed the period was half pre-released, as in every earlier year, and sized abs_move around 3% instead of 8%.

The CEO's exact words on H2 ('drugie półrocze jest trochę gorsze', FY '50-55 proc. wzrostu') come from the Polish PAP/Strefa Inwestorów call write-up. English summaries (Quartr) carried only the 700m figure, which hides the implied +28-45% H2 range.
Trigon's Q3 bar (+50% revenue, +60-70% net profit) is in a Polish-language GPW-sponsored research PDF. No English source carries a Q3 2026 number.
Insider transaction prices and volumes come only from the Polish MAR art. 19 notice attachments.
The issuer's own report schedule (RB 5/2026, Q3 on 17 Nov) and the release timestamps used in session_check are on Polish ESPI mirrors (StockWatch).
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number already told is worth 0' and 'the move is in the guide': I checked both and nothing is pre-released. abs_move_pct stays at 8.0 on the 'numbers are new' base (7.4% measured) plus thin turnover. I did not shrink it.
The 'cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco) lesson made me add the inventory-driven cash-flow risk under new_in_release. I have no Q3 number, so it is not a finding.

'Your own caveat has to reach the number' and 'the bar is unsourced or disputed': the CEO-framing finding went from -1.0 to -0.8, because his two statements (700m vs 50-55%) disagree and the Q3 bar rests on one broker.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' / habitual-buyer caveat: the insider-buying finding went from +0.7 to +0.5.
'A finding that lands inside what is already expected goes toward 0': the margin finding went from +0.3 to +0.2, because Trigon already assumes the y/y margin gain.
p_up moved from 47 to 48, toward 50, because every lean rests on inference or partly priced facts. expected_move_pct went from -0.48 to -0.32.
'Open session_check with the verdict only when you have a timestamp': no release timestamp exists, so it opens with 'Unresolved' and gives the issuer's mixed timestamp history.
